generator: phrase-match: scripts retrieve (data/idioms.json v1, lookup score 100), the model selects the reading and ranks analogs

prompt_components.purpose: Register-faithful, context-correct rendering; register fidelity matters more than literal meaning
task_decomposition: list all readings of the phrase
state which reading the context selects and why
rank target-language analogs by register and pragmatics
prompt_components.output_contract: each entry in analyses[]: context → reading_selected + evidence, readings_rejected, ranked analogs per language with register/pragmatics/sources, escape-hatch status
prompt_components.contrastive_example: analyses[] itself: the same phrase under two contexts yields different renderings
prompt_components.escape_hatch: if no idiomatic equivalent exists, escape_hatch_used=true and only register-matched paraphrases (sources: []) are offered — presented as paraphrases, never as cited facts
prompt_components.grounding_rule: every URL below returned HTTP 200 to scripts/verify_refs.py on verification.checked; analogs without sources are explicitly unverified

analyses.context: Коллега торопит с решением по сделке.
analyses.evidence: «торопит с решением» — someone presses for a decision; no real horses anywhere in the context

readings_rejected.reason: the context contains no horses, coach, or harness — a literal rendering here would be the classic idiom trap

de.text: Immer langsam mit den jungen Pferden!
de.pragmatics: keeps the horse imagery; direct appeal to slow down — fits collegial banter
de.caveat: too jocular for formal writing; use rank 2 there

de.pragmatics: neutral 'calm down / no rush'; loses the horse imagery but is safe in any spoken register

en.pragmatics: direct appeal to the listener to slow down; closest pragmatic match, same imagery
warns of the consequences of hurrying; less direct than the Russian imperative

analyses.context: Кучер настегивал лошадей, и телега неслась под гору.
analyses.evidence: «кучер», «телега», «лошадей» — real horses are being driven; the idiomatic reading does not apply

readings_rejected.reason: no one is being urged to hurry with an action or decision; the horses are literal

analyses.escape_hatch_reason: a literal reading needs a plain translation, not an idiom; the translations below are unverified paraphrases by design

de.text: Treib die Pferde nicht so an.
de.pragmatics: plain literal translation; use only when real horses are meant

en.text: Don't drive the horses so hard.
en.pragmatics: plain literal translation; use only when real horses are meant
